title: Skip Shanghai's Towers? Suzhou Is 2,500 Years Old, 30 Min Away | China Travel Expert
description:
Most first-timers burn their whole trip on Shanghai's skyline. Thirty minutes away by high-speed train sits a city that makes the case for slowing down.

Suzhou is about 2,500 years old and still laced with canals — the reason it's long been called the "Venice of the East." It also holds the Classical Gardens of Suzhou, a UNESCO World Heritage group of nine gardens — more UNESCO-listed gardens than any other city in the world.

🧭 Expert Tip: visit the gardens on a weekday morning. Weekends and holidays pack the famous ones (Humble Administrator's, Lingering Garden) shoulder to shoulder.

上海的高楼之外，30 分钟高铁就到苏州：2500 年的运河城，"东方威尼斯"，还有九座世界遗产园林——全球拥有世遗园林最多的城市。
